description: My best friend Jack trusted the wrong person. By the time I understood why, he was already gone.

Jack started dating a quiet girl from our class named Elisa. Then he changed. He pulled away, he snapped at strangers, and one night he came to my door crying black tears. What I followed into the woods behind my building was a thing I still cannot explain.
A Scroll Kaos horror story, told in our own words. Watch until the very end.
